controles.affirmation: Le 10-Q indique que Salesforce a annonce que certains gros clients Veeva CRM se sont engages a acheter ses solutions CRM et que des clients ont fait part de leur intention de passer chez Salesforce
controles.verbatim_source: For example, Salesforce, our primary CRM competitor, has announced that certain large Veeva CRM customers have committed to purchasing its CRM solutions and a number of our customers have informed us of their intent to move to Salesforce as their CRM provider.

controles.affirmation: Veeva CRM ne sera supporte que jusqu'au 31 decembre 2029
controles.verbatim_source: Veeva CRM will be supported until December 31, 2029.

controles.affirmation: Le taux de retention nette des abonnements avait une valeur stable au-dessus de 119% de FY2017 a FY2022 et n'est plus publie depuis quatre exercices
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2022 : 'For our fiscal years ended January 31, 2022, 2021, and 2020, our subscription services revenue retention rate was 119%, 124%, and 121%, respectively.' Serie complete FY2017-FY2022 relevee dans les 10-K : 127%, 121%, 122%, 121%, 124%, 119%. Aucune valeur dans les 10-K FY2023, FY2024, FY2025, FY2026 (verification faite sur les 4 documents).
controles.correction_proposee: La disparition de l'indicateur sur quatre exercices consecutifs est exacte et verifiee. Corriger la seule formulation 'stable au-dessus de 119%' : la valeur FY2022 est exactement 119%, pas au-dessus. Ecrire 'compris entre 119% et 127% de FY2017 a FY2022' ou 'jamais inferieur a 119%'.

controles.affirmation: Les dix plus gros clients ont represente 28% du chiffre d'affaires total sur chacun des exercices 2024, 2025 et 2026 ; base totale de 1552 clients
controles.verbatim_source: In each of our fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, our top 10 customers accounted for 28% of our total revenues. / As of January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, we served 1,552, 1,477, and 1,432 customers, respectively.

controles.affirmation: La quasi-totalite du chiffre d'affaires provient du secteur des sciences de la vie
controles.verbatim_source: Nearly all of our revenues are generated by sales to customers in the life sciences industry, and factors that adversely affect this industry (including government funding and staffing of relevant agencies and research, drug pricing regulation, healthcare funding and eligibility reforms, regulation of pharmaceutical advertising, or other regulatory or policy changes) could also adversely affect us.

controles.affirmation: SBC de 119,3 M$ soit 45,7% du resultat net GAAP de 260,9 M$ ; resultat net non-GAAP 371,1 M$ (+42%) ; taux d'impot effectif passe de 23,6% a 24,9% du fait de deficiences fiscales discretes liees a la remuneration en actions
controles.verbatim_source: Net income on a GAAP basis $260,936 / Stock-based compensation expense 119,259 / Net income on a non-GAAP basis $371,137 (milliers de $). 'For the three months ended April 30, 2026 and 2025, our effective tax rates were 24.9 % and 23.6 %, respectively... our effective tax rate increased primarily due to discrete tax deficiencies related to equity compensation.' Recalcul : 119259/260936 = 45,7% ; 371137/260936 = +42,2%.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance possible : le resultat non-GAAP exclut aussi 3,0 M$ d'amortissement d'incorporels et un effet d'impot de -12,1 M$, pas uniquement la SBC. La formulation 'qui exclut cette charge' pourrait devenir 'qui exclut notamment cette charge'.

controles.affirmation: Marge brute totale 75,0% au T1 FY2027, en baisse de 2,1 points ; marge brute abonnements 86,4% en baisse de 1,2 point ; chiffre d'affaires +16,3%
controles.verbatim_source: Total gross margin percentage 75 % / 77 % (tableau 10-Q). Recalcul depuis le compte de resultat : marge brute 662 024/882 948 = 74,98% vs 585 219/759 043 = 77,10% (-2,12 pt) ; marge abonnements (730 175-99 103)/730 175 = 86,43% vs (634 768-78 346)/634 768 = 87,66% (-1,23 pt) ; CA 882 948/759 043 = +16,32%.

controles.affirmation: Abonnements Commercial Solutions +10,6% contre R&D and Quality Solutions +19,1% sur un an
controles.verbatim_source: Subscription / Commercial Solutions $337,866 $305,411 / R&D and Quality Solutions 392,309 329,357. Recalcul : +10,63% et +19,11%.

controles.affirmation: 7,3 Mds$ de tresorerie et placements, sans dette
controles.verbatim_source: As of April 30, 2026, our cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $7.3 billion. Bilan : aucun poste de dette financiere (passifs non courants = impots differes 1 148, dettes de loyer 89 936, autres 32 350).

note: Aucune affirmation judiciaire ou reglementaire dans cette ATT. Un seul defaut, de formulation, sur la borne du taux de retention.
